name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

accounts.evidence: Her campaign site's social icon rows link to https://twitter.com/AOC as her Twitter account.
The campaign site footer says 'Follow Alexandria's campaign on Twitter' and links to http://twitter.com/teamaoc.

notes: AOC is her main personal account; teamaoc is the campaign account.
